limitations: Acceptance is only P06-A01 at simulated evidence level for original source 84b6ca0ca75fba248ba330642bbf8764db3d459c. Review replay is not a new native execution; the candidate validator/analyzer changes do not inherit a new-source native or full-host-suite result.

The configuration is RV64 p02-tfr SimX timing-model execution, one cluster/core, four warps of four threads, issue width one, FP16/BF16 inputs and FP32 output. No processor RTL, AFU emulation, physical FPGA or silicon result is established here.

Every invocation uses a fresh process and device context. The retained warm-up does not establish warm device caches, resident weights, reused allocations, multiple live operations, concurrent queues, or steady-state throughput.

Whole-context active cycles include all model launches and are not synchronized model latency or per-kernel timing. Macroinstructions are not FLOPs; overlapping stall counters cannot be summed as an elapsed interval.

Logical tensor payload, destination poison, argument payload and modeled 64-byte memory requests have distinct boundaries. They do not establish physical bandwidth, a tensor roofline, measured DMA traffic, or physical memory capacity.

Twelve disabled L2/L3 counters are unavailable, not zero. Included local-memory counters are measured zero in this suite. Per-launch-reset cache-port bank counters are deliberately excluded from whole-context totals.

Host process duration includes supervisor exit-observation/cleanup, startup, instrumentation, numerical checks and allowed host work. A reachable approximately 100 ms monitor delay is documented; exact historical exit timestamps are absent and no delay is subtracted retrospectively.
Five measured repetitions support the retained descriptive statistics only; no outlier is removed and no production tail-latency, confidence-interval, causal bottleneck or optimization claim is made.

The model includes declared host ReLU, exact format conversion and row assembly. Only its three matrix operations are dispatched through the native runtime; this is not proof of an entirely device-resident model.

Source audit checks all 979 retained bodies and all five top-level gitlinks per format. Three unrelated nested CVFPU gitlinks were not fetched, no retained body falls under them, and FetchContent historical tag immutability is not established. Exhaustive system/build-input retention and toolchain origin are not independently proved by source-byte matching.
